events.title: Iran War Escalation

actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The ongoing conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to increased prices and volatility. This could have a significant impact on the global economy, and investors should be prepared for potential market fluctuations. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) may be a good buy as a hedge against potential losses, while the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO) may be a good short as oil prices could drop if the conflict is resolved.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust positions as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if the conflict is resolved or if oil prices stabilize
